meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会检查或配置 claude-mem 与 cmem.ai Pro 的云同步:写入 token、user id 和 SyncHub URL,重启 worker,并报告设备 ID、待同步数量、最后刷新时间与 Hub 可达性。
howto.when: 当你提到「set up cloud sync」「sync my memories」「cmem pro」等关键词,或想把记忆库备份、同步到 cmem.ai 账号时触发。

say.text: 看一下我的云同步状态
say.note: 会查询本地状态接口并报告结果

say.text: 帮我设置云同步,连接值我来提供
say.note: 会写入三个连接值并重启验证

say.text: 我的记忆同步到 cmem.ai 了吗
say.note: 会报告 Hub 可达性和待同步数量

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can check or set up claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro: write the token, user id and SyncHub URL, restart the worker, and report device id, pending counts, last flush and Hub reachability.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories" or "cmem pro", or want your memory database backed up to cmem.ai.

say_en.note: Queries the local status route and reports it

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync; I'll give you the connection values
say_en.note: Writes the values, restarts and verifies

say_en.text: Are my memories synced to cmem.ai?
say_en.note: Reports Hub reachability and pending counts
